data.title: ship the public v1 benchmark, gallery, and model sweep

data.body: human: first reporting milestone is sealed v1.0.0-sample.1 after commits 1-7 and all gates: four five-trial runs over the same frozen probe forms, one per protocol, preferably cheapest qualifying multimodal endpoint with enclosure.plain-v1; exactly 20 paid calls, full suite/protocol registry, stop and report before broad sweep. plan updated without weakening spend/privacy safeguards.

implementation commits 1-7 complete on feat/public-v1-release. gates: ruff clean; host full pytest 7425 passed, 16 optional-runtime skips; cairo suite rerun verified all 11600 cells; visual small-suite collision regression passed in the pinned container. paid calls: 0. exact sample policy is four protocols x five frozen probe forms with max_transport_attempts=1, so retries cannot exceed 20 provider attempts. ready for independent review before endpoint planning or spend.

provenance.reason: implementation 1-7 complete and gated; independent review required before paid sample run

data.body: independent review: changes requested. blockers: endpoint selection does not prove membership in openrouters authenticated zdr endpoint set; the global/cohort spend cap is isolated per run rather than shared. high: admission/sealing does not reconcile exact call, trial, ledger, and usage counts; run identity omits execution-defining provenance; publication scan and gallery requirements are incomplete. standards: provider adapters live in the documented provider-neutral core, the old developer command is stale, and one scorer state annotation is missing. paid calls remain 0. fix and re-review before sample execution.

data.body: review rework complete in 410fc37. blockers/highs resolved: one locked/fsynced release ledger enforces aggregate global/cohort caps across run directories; authenticated model endpoints intersect exact model/tag/provider rows with the authenticated zdr catalog; sample sealing proves four protocol runs x the exact five frozen probe forms x one attempt, exact 20 calls, 40 ledger events, provider ids/usage/cost, matching human approval, complete derived profiles, and a built site. run identity now covers resolved model, endpoint/provider, routing/privacy, exact sdk versions, billing, generation/retry policy, and catalog provenance. provider/cli adapters moved to dbench; core orchestration/accounting is provider-neutral. site now exposes worked paths, prompts/confounds/form membership, symbolic/payload hashes, profiles/effects, checksums/caveats, local human fields, and byte-identical sealed rebuilds. publication scanning checks actual env secrets without printing them, host paths, headers/metadata, and decoded parquet; admission sanitizes transcripts. inspect and sdk retries are both zero for the 20-attempt sample. gates: ruff clean; 61 focused tests passed; 7447 non-cairo tests passed with 14 optional-runtime skips. full host run reached 7490 passed/14 skipped; only 14 failures and 9 fixture errors in the known gallery class lacked native libcairo. prior pinned-cairo 11600-cell verification remains unchanged. paid calls: 0.

data.body: implemented the third-review sealed-truth rework in 4859e2a. run ids and call ids now share one authoritative identity definition with planning and are recomputed before execution and admission. admission reparses response_text against the frozen protocol target and rejects self-asserted parse, prediction, or correctness. release validation derives the exact provider-attempt set, closes calls and ordered reservation/settlement pairs release-wide, rejects orphans and duplicate request ids, reconciles each cost, and enforces stored global/cohort caps. prepare and validation now share one deterministic profile/effect derivation; validation compares every published table row/value and the site consumes only verified derived rows. pages rebuilds the sealed site and requires exact path/checksum equality. probe is a real guarded execution command over the five-form set and preserves the sample 4 x 5/one-attempt contract. participant codes enforce the published 3-64 pattern in schema/python/html/js. dbench now normalizes known prompt/completion/image prices into provider-neutral execution identity; lofbench never reads openrouter catalog pricing. exact forgery tests cover run_forged, not-json claimed valid/correct, orphan 29.999 settlement, global/cohort overruns, forged profile/effect rows, bad participant codes, and site mismatch. gates: clean-room frozen sync and ruff passed; clean-room full pytest 7490 passed and 16 skipped; final focused post-audit gate 95 passed. native cairo was not rerun because this host lacks it and no suite/renderer implementation changed. paid calls: zero.

data.body: implemented the fourth-review authority/evidence boundary redesign. protocols/v1.json is now a checked-in registry authority beside suites/v1.json; release AuthorityManifest records the source commit, git blobs, exact byte sha256 digests, paths, and sizes, and repository-aware validation reads git show at that recorded commit rather than the mutable worktree. RunAuthority canonical sha256 digests bind registry bytes, exact selected forms/cells, selected protocol, endpoint catalog evidence, and the provider-neutral execution spec into the sole run identity used by planning, pre-execution validation, admission, and sealed validation. optional transcript dictionaries were replaced with exact one-per-call AttemptEvidence records whose digest covers completion, request id, model, provider, endpoint, usage, cost, latency, status, and deterministic sanitized raw evidence; CallRecord and TrialRecord link the digest and contradictions/missing/extra/duplicate evidence fail closed. attempts, tokens, costs, and latency now recompute from calls with finite/nonnegative validation while prior ledger, scorer, metrics, site, secret, endpoint, and human-schema gates remain. adversarial regressions cover all four latest proofs plus the prior matrix. gates: original red loop 7 failed then 7 passed; expanded authority/evidence matrix 20 passed; release bundle 57 passed; full suite 7518 passed, 16 skipped; ruff and git diff check clean. frozen cairo suite was not rerun because suite/renderer data and code are unchanged; prior pinned-cairo 11600-cell verification remains applicable. paid/model calls: zero.

data.body: review cycle 6 implementation complete at 96580e6. provider-neutral lofbench now owns the exact immutable evidence envelope, explicit attempt statuses, total fail-closed projection contract, append-only evidence revisions, and accounting-recovery port; lofbench imports no dbench code. the direct openrouter adapter retains http status, response headers, exact/partial raw bytes, verified text/json parse outcome, timing, transport failures, and every bounded generation lookup. one canonicalized projector closes chat/generation error, cancellation, finish reason, request/model/provider/endpoint identity, prompt/completion/reasoning tokens, cost, and provider/measured latency. orchestration fsyncs evidence and call records before settlement or scoring; accounting_unknown keeps its conservative reservation, stops the run, and resume performs generation-only recovery without resending inference. only complete attempts produce trials. release validation reprojects final evidence, verifies revision chains and every call/trial link, while dbench owns openrouter/sample policy and lofsite consumes only PublicationView. docs/pages use the application facade. gates: clean-room frozen sync passed; focused evidence/runner/openrouter/cli/wheel 63 passed; release/site 68 passed; installed-wheel gate 1 passed; full 7547 passed, 16 optional-runtime skips; ruff and diff checks clean. no inference or paid api calls; spend usd 0. remaining risk: direct provider transport is verified against adversarial mocked http exchanges rather than a live paid response; no suite/renderer code changed, so the prior pinned-cairo 11600-cell gate remains applicable.
